root.name: アングロゴールド・アシャンティ

companies.name: バリック・マイニング

relations.text: コンゴのキバリ金鉱山の合弁相手で、運営を担う
relations.text_en: Joint venture partner that operates the Kibali gold mine in the DRC

source.label: AngloGold Ashanti 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: AngloGold Ashanti's joint venture at Kibali in the DRC is managed by the Company's joint venture partner, Barrick.

companies.name: ゴールド・フィールズ

relations.text: ガーナの隣接鉱山(イドゥアプリエムとタルクワ)の統合合弁を提案(2025年5月に協議を中断)
relations.text_en: Proposed combining the neighboring Iduapriem and Tarkwa mines in Ghana; talks paused in May 2025

source.label: AngloGold Ashanti 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: In March 2023, AngloGold Ashanti and Gold Fields proposed a joint venture to combine their Iduapriem and Tarkwa gold mines in Ghana.
source.note: 協議は2025年5月に中断しています。

relations.text: キバリ合弁の10%を保有し、コンゴ政府の持分を代表
relations.text_en: Holds 10% of the Kibali joint venture on behalf of the DRC government

source.label: AngloGold Ashanti 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: ("SOKIMO") which holds a 10% interest in the Kibali joint venture and represents the interest of the DRC government.

relations.text: エジプトのスカリ金鉱山を持つCentaminを買収
relations.text_en: Acquired Centamin and its Sukari mine in Egypt

source.label: AngloGold Ashanti 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: Acquisition of Centamin plc, including the Sukari mine in Egypt.

companies.name: オーガスタ・ゴールド

relations.text: ネバダ州のAugusta Goldを2025年10月に買収
relations.text_en: Acquired Augusta Gold in Nevada in October 2025

source.label: AngloGold Ashanti 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: On 23 October 2025, AngloGold Ashanti completed its acquisition of Augusta Gold Corp.

relations.text: 残り80.5%を取得して完全子会社化
relations.text_en: Bought the remaining 80.5% of Corvus Gold

source.label: AngloGold Ashanti 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: Acquisition of the remaining 80.5% interest in Corvus Gold Inc.

relations.text: CoeurからネバダのSterling(Coeur Sterling)を全株取得
relations.text_en: Bought Coeur Sterling in Nevada from Coeur Mining

source.label: Coeur Mining 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Stock Purchase Agreement, dated September 18, 2022, by and among Coeur Mining, Inc., a Delaware corporation, AngloGold Ashanti (U.S.A.) Holdings Inc.

companies.name: リゾリュート・マイニング

relations.text: コートジボワールのDoropo・ABC計画を2025年5月に売却
relations.text_en: Sold the Doropo and ABC projects in Côte d'Ivoire to it in May 2025

source.label: AngloGold Ashanti 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: On 1 May 2025, AngloGold Ashanti completed the sale of the Doropo project and the Archean-Birimian Contact ("ABC") project in Côte d'Ivoire to Resolute Mining Limited ("Resolute").

relations.text: マリのSEMOS(サディオラ)の持分をIAMGOLDと共にAlliedへ売却
relations.text_en: Sold its SEMOS (Sadiola) interest in Mali to Allied Gold, together with IAMGOLD

source.label: Allied Gold 年次情報書(40-F添付、2025年度)
source.label_en: Allied Gold annual information form (40-F exhibit, FY2025)
source.quote: Allied took control of SEMOS on January 1, 2021 by purchasing the collective 80% interest in SEMOS held by AngloGold Ashanti Limited (" AGA ") and IAMGOLD Corporation (" IMG ") pursuant to a share purchase agreement dated December 18, 2020.
